Experimental work in flow-controlled reaction systems demonstrates that these networks can produce programmable, history-dependent outputs distinct from simple hysteresis, offering a basis for neuromorphic-like chemical behavior. Research continues to define the boundary between persistent non-equilibrium states and functional memory.
